method: headless Chrome DOM + geometry + canvas-pixel + persisted-state mirror only; no vision. Screenshots are hashed mirrors, not inspected visually. Report parity anchored to the game's OWN catchUp oracle on a seed clone at the DOM's exact awayTicks.

fixtureScrutiny.a: Only setup seeding mutates state: fixtures are docs/evidence/yard-mature.json payload.sim VERBATIM (cap/long/short/large) or createInitialState() (zero), re-encoded with the game's OWN encodeSave and lastSeenMs=Date.now()-gap in the past. No sim field edited. A probe-only 'rw61.seeded' marker writes the seed once per context so reloads read the game's own persisted save. Every action is a real UI click/tap/key/scroll/reload.
fixtureScrutiny.b: Documented in this probe header, the FIXTURES table and results.json.
fixtureScrutiny.c: Every seeded envelope passes the game's full decodeSave/repairRegistration/validateSim (asserted). Boot steps assert the loaded mirror kept the seed's machines/routes/tutorial. Report gains/credits/deliveries/batches/bottleneck are compared to the game's OWN catchUp run on a seed clone at the DOM's awayTicks — exact, not hand-written. No invariant weakened.
fixtureScrutiny.d: No action faked by injection; localStorage read only as the game's own persistence mirror. Clipboard success uses a real granted permission; refusal/missing-API branches are unit-covered (return-61.test.tsx), not faked here.

findings.detail: adoptCatchUp credits an absence exactly once and moves lastSeenMs to nowMs before the panel mounts. The redesign has one resume action and no claim/dispatch; dismiss, Menu re-open, Escape and reload all leave the ledger unchanged (proven by 03/04/05/06 and the byte-equal idle reload).

The catch-up loading moment is App.tsx's single `.reconcile` role=status line ('Catching your yard up'), painted only while isReconciling() and never as a dialog. #61 does not edit App.tsx; the probe records it via a pre-script MutationObserver and asserts no [role=dialog] appears.

The live probe exercises the clipboard SUCCESS path with a real granted permission. The refusal and missing-API branches (copyFailed note) are covered deterministically in return-61.test.tsx via configurable navigator.clipboard stubs; they are not faked in the live probe.

A reload after the steps have run measures a small real gap (lastSeen moved to now at adoption), so a tiny inline report may reappear; awayTicks collapses below the drift bound and the store never jumps by a second cap's gains. LEASE_TTL_MS=1500 makes a 60s-gap reload a legitimate writer re-claim, not a double credit.
